title: Grateful Dead Live at Yale Bowl, Yale University on 1971-07-31
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne;Soundboard (shnid:132730)SBD -> Master Reel -> CD,CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC; Audience (shnid:101438)Sources:I: AudMR > CD > EAC > WAV > SHN,II: AudMR > C > DAT > CD > EAC > WAV > SHN,single AKG 190E mic > Uher 4000 Report-L 5" Reel deck, 1/2 track tapes on a Revox A-700 (tweaked the head azimuth to match the original recording).  Signal fed into DigiDesign Pro Tools on a Macintosh with Audio Media III sound card. The only post processing was normalization.

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a tight Sugar Magnolia and soaring Dark Star, delivering an inspired yet slightly uneven ’71 performance.
ai_review.review: The matrix source is exceptionally treated, offering clear instrument separation and a polished mix that lets the band’s instrumental prowess shine. The show delivers high‑energy highlights like a razor‑tight Sugar Magnolia and a monster Dark Star into China > Rider, though, as typical of 1971 shows, some moments feel uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with standout jams and high energy (70% weight) plus an excellent matrix recording (30% weight) yields a solid combined rating; three detailed, consistently positive reviews give moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Thoroughly treated mix with clear instrument separation and balanced levels; vocals slightly recessed but overall very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid pacing with a tight Sugar Magnolia early on and a powerful second‑set sequence featuring Dark Star into China > Rider; overall flow is engaging despite occasional unevenness typical of ’71 shows.
